set.body: Design-only gate for possible Ravel-backed Gale storage. Ravel currently keeps ArraySource, storage, layout, offsets, and strides private; CanonicalArray provides logical linear access but no raw-storage escape. Decide whether a public or experimental monomorphic Double SPI can dispatch once and give trusted Gale kernels read/write access to storage identity, offset, dimensions, and strides on JVM and Scala.js without leaking mutable aliases or moving linear algebra into Ravel. Acceptance criteria: define immutable and exclusive-mutable capability lifetimes; map JVM Array[Double] and Scala.js Float64Array; support same-storage alias checks and Gale backend handoff; choose a compatibility-safe artifact/API placement; and validate a minimal prototype. A reasoned no-go is acceptable and must recommend retaining copy-only interop.
set.title: Design a safe monomorphic Double kernel-view SPI
